# moval.living

> A locally curated guide to Moreno Valley, California businesses, events, homes, parks, and community stories.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.moval.living/): Local businesses, events, stories, and community resources.
- [Search businesses](https://www.moval.living/search): Browse Moreno Valley businesses by category and keyword.
- [Community events](https://www.moval.living/events): Calendar of events in Moreno Valley and nearby Inland Empire venues.
- [Homes for sale](https://www.moval.living/homes): Active residential listings powered by CRMLS.
- [Open houses](https://www.moval.living/open-houses): Upcoming open houses and map search powered by CRMLS.
- [Parks](https://www.moval.living/parks): Moreno Valley parks and outdoor recreation guide.
- [About Moreno Valley](https://www.moval.living/about-moreno-valley): Local context, demographics, lifestyle, and market information.
- [Life in MoVal](https://www.moval.living/life): First-person local observations and community stories.
- [Insights](https://www.moval.living/insights): Guest perspectives and useful local guides.

## Categories

Browse Moreno Valley businesses by category. Each page has a hand-written intro, live business count, FAQ block, and Schema.org ItemList + BreadcrumbList + FAQPage JSON-LD for AI crawlers.

- [Restaurants & Dining](https://www.moval.living/category/restaurants): Local eateries, cafes, food trucks, and catering.
- [Contractors & Construction](https://www.moval.living/category/contractors): Home builders, remodelers, plumbers, electricians.
- [Healthcare & Medical](https://www.moval.living/category/healthcare): Doctors, dentists, clinics, pharmacies, specialists.
- [Retail & Shopping](https://www.moval.living/category/retail): Boutiques, shops, stores, and e-commerce locals.
- [Auto Repair](https://www.moval.living/category/auto-repair): Auto repair shops, mechanics, body shops, tire shops, car washes, and towing.
- [Auto Dealers](https://www.moval.living/category/auto-dealers): New and used car dealerships, dealer groups, and vehicle sales.
- [Churches](https://www.moval.living/category/churches): Churches, ministries, and other faith communities.
- [Property Management](https://www.moval.living/category/property-management): Apartment communities, shopping centers, plazas, and other managed properties.
- [Non-Profits](https://www.moval.living/category/non-profits): Charitable, civic, cultural, and service organizations serving Moreno Valley.
- [Supply & Logistics](https://www.moval.living/category/supply-logistics): Trucking, warehousing, distribution, foreign trade zones, material handling, and wholesale supply.
- [Entertainment](https://www.moval.living/category/entertainment): Movie theaters, bowling alleys, trampoline parks, escape rooms, immersive experiences, event venues, and live entertainment.
- [Professional Services](https://www.moval.living/category/professional): Attorneys, accountants, real estate, marketing, business consulting.
- [Insurance Services](https://www.moval.living/category/insurance): Auto, home, life, health, and commercial insurance agents.
- [Dispensaries](https://www.moval.living/category/dispensaries): Licensed cannabis dispensaries and delivery services.
- [Hospitality](https://www.moval.living/category/hospitality): Hotels, motels, inns, and extended-stay lodging.
- [Service Clubs](https://www.moval.living/category/service-clubs): Rotary, Lions, Kiwanis, Optimist, Elks, and similar community service clubs.
- [Beauty & Wellness](https://www.moval.living/category/beauty): Salons, spas, gyms, yoga, nails, barbers.
- [Home Services](https://www.moval.living/category/home-services): Landscaping, cleaning, pest control, HVAC, painting.
- [Education & Tutoring](https://www.moval.living/category/education): Schools, tutors, music lessons, driving instructors.
- [Pets & Veterinary](https://www.moval.living/category/pets): Vets, pet stores, grooming, dog walking, boarding.
- [Banks & Financial](https://www.moval.living/category/finance): Banks, credit unions, loan officers, financial advisors.
- [Real Estate & Mortgage](https://www.moval.living/category/real-estate): Realtors, mortgage brokers, title companies, property managers.

## About the site

moval.living is maintained as a Moreno Valley community directory and local guide. Business profiles are published listings and should be independently verified before making purchasing, safety, medical, financial, or real-estate decisions.

Real-estate listing data is provided through CRMLS and includes the site's IDX disclaimer. Market information is informational, not financial or legal advice.
